cohort: Pregnant women with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection receiving hospital care at a Spanish tertiary hospital were included and compared to all births at the same hospital during the study period.
finding: Pregnant women admitted with COVID-19 had increased risks of adverse obstetric and neonatal outcomes, and vaccination significantly reduced the risk of hospitalization.
mod_finding: Hospitalized pregnant women with COVID-19 had a significantly higher rate of cesarean delivery.
